label_semantics.AMBIGUOUS: Two or more identity interpretations remain equally lawful.
label_semantics.DIFFERENT: Evidence supports an identity break or different referents.
label_semantics.NOT_EVALUABLE: Available cutoff-safe evidence cannot support a scientific label.
label_semantics.SAME: Evidence supports one persistent referent across the edge.

definitions.candidate_ambiguity: Candidate disposition AMBIGUOUS; never silently coerced to SAME or DIFFERENT.
definitions.false_continuity: After blinded adjudication labels an edge DIFFERENT, a candidate disposition SAME on that edge.
definitions.false_fragmentation: After blinded adjudication labels an edge SAME, a candidate disposition DIFFERENT or NO_CORRESPONDENCE on that edge.
definitions.hard_falsification: A candidate disposition SAME across a confirmed D1 hard constitutional break. This is an automatic candidate-level falsification independent of human labels.
definitions.not_evaluable: Evidence available at evaluation_cutoff cannot lawfully support SAME, DIFFERENT or AMBIGUOUS.

final_analysis.error_matrix: Compute false_split and false_join only over human-adjudicated SAME/DIFFERENT edges; AMBIGUOUS and NOT_EVALUABLE remain separate denominators.
final_analysis.pareto_rule: Candidate dominated if weakly worse on false_split and false_join and strictly worse on at least one, conditional on no hard falsification.
final_analysis.recommendation_rule: Recommend only a uniquely non-falsified, non-dominated candidate with no concealed year/side/clock failure; otherwise DEFER.

positive_same_anchor_policy.rule: Absence of a hard break is necessary but not sufficient for SAME. Final SAME labels require blinded adjudication using cutoff-safe evidence.

unit_of_analysis.description: A candidate-independent ordered source pair within one hard scope, joined to each frozen candidate's identity disposition at the current evaluation cutoff.
unit_of_analysis.name: candidate_identity_edge
